cli.help:
TendKit (Go)

Usage:
  tendkit [global options]
  tendkit version [global options]

Default behavior:
  Start the interactive terminal and initialize missing files under the current user's TendKit configuration directory

Commands:
  version    Show version

Global options:
  --config PATH   Configuration file path (default: %s)
  --lock PATH     Lock file path (default: config path plus .lock; currently %s)
  --color MODE    Color mode: auto, always, never
  --lang LANG     Language: zh, en (default: system locale)
  --env-file PATH Load a specific environment file
  --no-env-file   Disable all environment-file loading

tui.help.workers: Controls how many applications are processed concurrently during batch checks or updates. Each task runs version detection and update work independently.
tui.help.http_concurrency: Limits simultaneous HTTP version-check requests to the same host. Different hosts can still be processed in parallel.
tui.help.timeout: Sets how long an individual shell command may produce no output during an update; it is not the total batch update deadline.
